hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: A Clanker token launch hook with volatility-based dynamic LP fees. It simulates swaps to estimate tick movement, computes LP fees from a volatility accumulator, and collects a 20% protocol fee on paired-token flows via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta manipulation. Supports an optional MEV module that can temporarily spike fees during the first 2 minutes after pool creation.
